name: example
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 6 * * *'   # daily-ish — keeps the README sample fresh

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Self-test: invoke the action that lives in this very repo.
      - name: osalt-freshness against a known-alive set
        id: alive_set
        uses: ./
        with:
          repos: |
            grafana/grafana
            n8n-io/n8n
            supabase/supabase
            nextcloud/server
            laurent22/joplin

      - name: Sanity-check outputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "alive=${{ steps.alive_set.outputs.alive-count }}"
          echo "stale=${{ steps.alive_set.outputs.stale-count }}"
          echo "dead=${{ steps.alive_set.outputs.dead-count }}"
          echo "unknown=${{ steps.alive_set.outputs.unknown-count }}"
          test "${{ steps.alive_set.outputs.alive-count }}" -gt 0

      - name: osalt-freshness fail-on=dead (should pass — these are alive)
        uses: ./
        with:
          repos: grafana/grafana
          fail-on: dead

name: 'osalt freshness'
description: 'Check open-source repos in your build for freshness (alive / stale / dead) using the osalt.dev catalogue. Writes a markdown summary to the workflow with backlinks to alternatives.'
author: 'SolvoHQ'
branding:
  icon: 'shield'
  color: 'orange'

inputs:
  repos:
    description: 'Newline- or comma-separated `owner/name` repos to check. If empty, the action auto-detects from go.mod, package.json (github: shorthand only), requirements.txt, and Pipfile.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  paths:
    description: 'Comma-separated directories to scan when auto-detecting. Default `.`.'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  api-url:
    description: 'osalt.dev health endpoint. Override if you self-host the catalogue.'
    required: false
    default: 'https://osalt.dev/api/health.json'
  github-fallback:
    description: 'When a repo is NOT in osalt.dev, query the GitHub API directly to compute freshness. Set to `false` to silently skip unknown repos.'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  fail-on:
    description: 'Comma-separated set of statuses that fail the step. e.g. `dead` or `stale,dead`. Default empty = informational only.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  summary:
    description: 'Write a markdown table to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.'
    required: false
    default: 'true'

outputs:
  alive-count:
    description: 'Number of repos classified `alive`.'
    value: ${{ steps.check.outputs.alive }}
  stale-count:
    description: 'Number of repos classified `stale`.'
    value: ${{ steps.check.outputs.stale }}
  dead-count:
    description: 'Number of repos classified `dead`.'
    value: ${{ steps.check.outputs.dead }}
  unknown-count:
    description: 'Number of repos with no commit data.'
    value: ${{ steps.check.outputs.unknown }}
  json:
    description: 'Full result as JSON (array of {github, health, last_commit_age_days, source}).'
    value: ${{ steps.check.outputs.json }}

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - id: check
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_REPOS: ${{ inputs.repos }}
        INPUT_PATHS: ${{ inputs.paths }}
        INPUT_API_URL: ${{ inputs.api-url }}
        INPUT_GITHUB_FALLBACK: ${{ inputs.github-fallback }}
        INPUT_FAIL_ON: ${{ inputs.fail-on }}
        INPUT_SUMMARY: ${{ inputs.summary }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      run: bash "${{ github.action_path }}/run.sh"

# osalt-freshness-action

A GitHub Action that flags **stale or dead open-source repos** in your build
using the [osalt.dev](https://osalt.dev) catalogue (currently tracking
**~230 self-hostable tools** across 100 SaaS categories).

Drop it into any CI job — it scans your dependency manifests (or a list you pass
in), looks each repo up in our health index, and writes a markdown summary to
the workflow run with backlinks to alternatives on osalt.dev.

No API key. No signup. Zero state.

## Why this exists

If a tool in your stack hasn't shipped a commit in over a year, you usually
want to know. Most freshness tooling either requires you to set thresholds
yourself or bury the result in a JSON blob nobody reads. This action publishes
the result straight into `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` so it lands on the run page.

Repos in the [osalt.dev](https://osalt.dev) catalogue also get a `tool` page
link pointing at curated **self-host alternatives** — handy if you discover a
dependency is dead and need a migration path.

## Usage

```yaml
name: freshness
on:
  schedule: [{ cron: '0 9 * * 1' }]   # every Monday 9am UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: SolvoHQ/osalt-freshness-action@v0
        with:
          repos: |
            grafana/grafana
            n8n-io/n8n
            supabase/supabase
```

### Auto-detect from manifests

Omit `repos:` to scan the repo for direct GitHub dependencies in `go.mod`,
`requirements.txt`, `Pipfile`, `pyproject.toml`, and `package.json`
(`github:owner/name` shorthand only — registry packages are not resolved).

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: SolvoHQ/osalt-freshness-action@v0
  # no inputs — auto-scan
```

### Fail the build on dead deps

```yaml
- uses: SolvoHQ/osalt-freshness-action@v0
  with:
    repos: grafana/grafana, n8n-io/n8n
    fail-on: dead         # any combination of: alive, stale, dead, unknown
```

## Inputs

| name              | default                                 | description                                                       |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repos`           | _(empty — triggers auto-detect)_        | Newline- or comma-separated `owner/name` repos.                   |
| `paths`           | `.`                                     | Comma-separated dirs to scan when auto-detecting.                 |
| `api-url`         | `https://osalt.dev/api/health.json`     | Override if you self-host the catalogue.                          |
| `github-fallback` | `true`                                  | Query GitHub directly for repos not in osalt's catalogue.         |
| `fail-on`         | _(empty)_                               | Comma-separated statuses that fail the step.                      |
| `summary`         | `true`                                  | Write a markdown table to the workflow summary.                   |

## Outputs

| name            | description                                                |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `alive-count`   | Number of repos classified `alive` (commit ≤ 90 d).        |
| `stale-count`   | Number of repos classified `stale` (commit ≤ 365 d).       |
| `dead-count`    | Number of repos classified `dead` (commit > 365 d or archived). |
| `unknown-count` | Number of repos with no commit data / unreachable.         |
| `json`          | Full result as a JSON array.                               |

## Health classification

| status     | rule                                                |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| **alive**  | last commit within 90 days                          |
| **stale**  | last commit within 366 days                         |
| **dead**   | last commit > 365 days *or* repo archived           |
| **unknown** | no commit data / API unreachable                   |

Same thresholds as [osalt.dev/freshness](https://osalt.dev/freshness/).

## Privacy

The action makes anonymous HTTPS requests to `osalt.dev` (your repo list, no
tokens). On a cache miss it falls back to the GitHub REST API using the
workflow's automatic `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Nothing is logged on our side beyond
standard Vercel access logs.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# osalt-freshness-action — composite entrypoint.
# Reads INPUT_* env vars set by action.yml, writes $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY and
# $GITHUB_OUTPUT. Pure bash + curl + jq (preinstalled on GitHub-hosted runners).
set -euo pipefail

API_URL="${INPUT_API_URL:-https://osalt.dev/api/health.json}"
PATHS_RAW="${INPUT_PATHS:-.}"
REPOS_RAW="${INPUT_REPOS:-}"
GH_FALLBACK="${INPUT_GITHUB_FALLBACK:-true}"
FAIL_ON="${INPUT_FAIL_ON:-}"
WRITE_SUMMARY="${INPUT_SUMMARY:-true}"

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "::error::jq is required and missing on this runner."; exit 1; }
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "::error::curl is required and missing on this runner."; exit 1; }

normalize_repo() {
  # owner/name -> lowercase, strip .git, trim whitespace
  local s="$1"
  s="${s%.git}"
  s="${s#https://github.com/}"
  s="${s#git+https://github.com/}"
  s="${s#git@github.com:}"
  s="${s#github:}"
  # trim
  s="$(echo "$s" | awk '{$1=$1;print}')"
  # lowercase (GitHub repo paths are case-insensitive)
  echo "$s" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'
}

scan_manifests() {
  # Discover owner/name pairs from go.mod, requirements.txt, package.json, Pipfile
  local roots; IFS=',' read -ra roots <<<"$PATHS_RAW"
  local root
  for root in "${roots[@]}"; do
    root="$(echo "$root" | awk '{$1=$1;print}')"
    [ -z "$root" ] && continue
    [ ! -d "$root" ] && continue

    # go.mod — `github.com/owner/name v1.2.3`
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      grep -Eo 'github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+' "$f" 2>/dev/null \
        | sed 's|^github\.com/||' || true
    done < <(find "$root" -maxdepth 6 -name go.mod -type f 2>/dev/null)

    # requirements.txt / Pipfile — `git+https://github.com/owner/name(.git)?@ref`
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      grep -Eo 'github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+' "$f" 2>/dev/null \
        | sed 's|^github\.com/||' \
        | sed 's|\.git$||' || true
    done < <(find "$root" -maxdepth 6 \( -name requirements.txt -o -name Pipfile -o -name pyproject.toml \) -type f 2>/dev/null)

    # package.json — values matching `github:owner/name` or full URL.
    # We only catch direct-from-github deps, NOT registry packages.
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      jq -r '
        [(.dependencies // {}), (.devDependencies // {}), (.peerDependencies // {}), (.optionalDependencies // {})]
        | add // {} | to_entries[] | .value
      ' "$f" 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -Eo 'github(\.com)?[:/][A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+' \
        | sed -E 's|^github(\.com)?[:/]||' \
        | sed 's|\.git$||' || true
    done < <(find "$root" -maxdepth 6 -name package.json -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -type f 2>/dev/null)
  done
}

# 1. Resolve repo list ------------------------------------------------------
declare -A SEEN=()
REPOS=()
add_repo() {
  local r="$(normalize_repo "$1")"
  # `owner/name` only — reject anything that doesn't look like a path of exactly two segments
  if [[ "$r" =~ ^[a-z0-9_.-]+/[a-z0-9_.-]+$ ]]; then
    if [ -z "${SEEN[$r]:-}" ]; then
      SEEN[$r]=1
      REPOS+=("$r")
    fi
  fi
}

if [ -n "$REPOS_RAW" ]; then
  # split on newline OR comma
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    add_repo "$line"
  done < <(echo "$REPOS_RAW" | tr ',' '\n')
else
  echo "::group::Auto-detecting repos from manifests"
  while IFS= read -r r; do
    [ -z "$r" ] && continue
    add_repo "$r"
  done < <(scan_manifests)
  echo "Found ${#REPOS[@]} candidate repos."
  echo "::endgroup::"
fi

if [ "${#REPOS[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "::warning::No repos to check. Pass \`repos:\` or run inside a project with go.mod / requirements.txt / direct github deps in package.json."
  echo "alive=0" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "stale=0" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "dead=0"  >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "unknown=0" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "json=[]"   >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  if [ "$WRITE_SUMMARY" = "true" ] && [ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]; then
    {
      echo "## osalt freshness"
      echo
      echo "_No repos discovered. Pass \`with: repos:\` or add a go.mod / requirements.txt to the scanned paths._"
      echo
      echo "Powered by [osalt.dev](https://osalt.dev)."
    } >>"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# 2. Fetch osalt catalogue --------------------------------------------------
CATALOGUE="$(mktemp)"
if ! curl -fsSL -H 'User-Agent: osalt-freshness-action' "$API_URL" -o "$CATALOGUE"; then
  echo "::warning::Could not reach $API_URL — falling back to GitHub API for every repo."
  echo '{"repos":[]}' >"$CATALOGUE"
fi

# 3. Look up each repo ------------------------------------------------------
RESULTS=()
gh_fallback() {
  # echoes JSON object {health, last_commit_age_days, stars} or empty on failure
  local repo="$1"
  local hdr=(-H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' -H 'User-Agent: osalt-freshness-action' -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28')
  if [ -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then hdr+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"); fi
  local repo_json; repo_json="$(curl -fsSL "${hdr[@]}" "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  local stars archived pushed_at default_branch
  stars="$(echo "$repo_json" | jq -r '.stargazers_count // empty')"
  archived="$(echo "$repo_json" | jq -r '.archived // false')"
  pushed_at="$(echo "$repo_json" | jq -r '.pushed_at // empty')"
  default_branch="$(echo "$repo_json" | jq -r '.default_branch // empty')"
  local last_iso="$pushed_at"
  if [ -n "$default_branch" ]; then
    local commits_json
    commits_json="$(curl -fsSL "${hdr[@]}" "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/commits?sha=$default_branch&per_page=1" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    local cdate; cdate="$(echo "$commits_json" | jq -r '.[0].commit.committer.date // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [ -n "$cdate" ] && last_iso="$cdate"
  fi
  local age=""
  if [ -n "$last_iso" ]; then
    local last_epoch now_epoch
    last_epoch="$(date -u -d "$last_iso" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
    now_epoch="$(date -u +%s)"
    if [ -n "$last_epoch" ]; then age=$(( (now_epoch - last_epoch) / 86400 )); fi
  fi
  local health="unknown"
  if [ "$archived" = "true" ]; then
    health="dead"
  elif [ -n "$age" ]; then
    if   [ "$age" -le 90 ]; then health="alive"
    elif [ "$age" -le 365 ]; then health="stale"
    else                          health="dead"
    fi
  fi
  jq -nc --arg repo "$repo" --arg health "$health" --arg age "$age" --arg stars "$stars" --arg last "$last_iso" --arg src "github" \
    '{github:$repo, health:$health, last_commit_age_days:(if $age=="" then null else ($age|tonumber) end), stars:(if $stars=="" then null else ($stars|tonumber) end), last_commit_at:(if $last=="" then null else $last end), source:$src}'
}

alive=0; stale=0; dead=0; unknown=0
for repo in "${REPOS[@]}"; do
  hit="$(jq --arg r "$repo" -c '.repos[]? | select((.github|ascii_downcase) == $r)' "$CATALOGUE" || true)"
  if [ -n "$hit" ]; then
    enriched="$(echo "$hit" | jq -c '{github, health, last_commit_age_days, stars, last_commit_at, tool_slug, tool_url, listed_under, source: "osalt"}')"
  elif [ "$GH_FALLBACK" = "true" ]; then
    enriched="$(gh_fallback "$repo" || true)"
    if [ -z "$enriched" ]; then
      enriched="$(jq -nc --arg r "$repo" '{github:$r, health:"unknown", last_commit_age_days:null, stars:null, last_commit_at:null, source:"unreachable"}')"
    fi
  else
    enriched="$(jq -nc --arg r "$repo" '{github:$r, health:"unknown", last_commit_age_days:null, stars:null, last_commit_at:null, source:"not-in-catalogue"}')"
  fi
  h="$(echo "$enriched" | jq -r '.health')"
  case "$h" in
    alive)   alive=$((alive+1)) ;;
    stale)   stale=$((stale+1)) ;;
    dead)    dead=$((dead+1)) ;;
    *)       unknown=$((unknown+1)) ;;
  esac
  RESULTS+=("$enriched")
done

JSON="$(printf '%s\n' "${RESULTS[@]}" | jq -sc .)"

# 4. Emit outputs -----------------------------------------------------------
{
  echo "alive=$alive"
  echo "stale=$stale"
  echo "dead=$dead"
  echo "unknown=$unknown"
  # Multiline outputs use the heredoc syntax
  echo "json<<__OSALT_EOF__"
  echo "$JSON"
  echo "__OSALT_EOF__"
} >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# 5. Markdown summary -------------------------------------------------------
status_badge() {
  case "$1" in
    alive) echo '![alive](https://img.shields.io/badge/alive-2ea44f)' ;;
    stale) echo '![stale](https://img.shields.io/badge/stale-d4a72c)' ;;
    dead)  echo '![dead](https://img.shields.io/badge/dead-d73a49)' ;;
    *)     echo '![unknown](https://img.shields.io/badge/unknown-6a737d)' ;;
  esac
}

if [ "$WRITE_SUMMARY" = "true" ] && [ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]; then
  {
    echo "## osalt freshness"
    echo
    echo "**${#REPOS[@]} repo(s)** checked · **$alive** alive · **$stale** stale · **$dead** dead · **$unknown** unknown"
    echo
    echo "| Repo | Status | Last commit | Stars | osalt page |"
    echo "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"
    for r in "${RESULTS[@]}"; do
      gh="$(echo  "$r" | jq -r '.github')"
      h="$(echo   "$r" | jq -r '.health')"
      age="$(echo "$r" | jq -r '.last_commit_age_days // empty')"
      st="$(echo  "$r" | jq -r '.stars // empty')"
      tu="$(echo  "$r" | jq -r '.tool_url // empty')"
      src="$(echo "$r" | jq -r '.source')"
      age_disp="—"
      if [ -n "$age" ]; then age_disp="${age}d ago"; fi
      star_disp="—"; [ -n "$st" ] && star_disp="$st"
      tool_disp="—"
      if [ -n "$tu" ]; then
        slug="$(echo "$r" | jq -r '.tool_slug')"
        tool_disp="[/tool/$slug/]($tu)"
      elif [ "$src" = "github" ]; then
        tool_disp="_(not catalogued — [submit](https://github.com/SolvoHQ/os-alt/issues))_"
      fi
      printf '| [`%s`](https://github.com/%s) | %s | %s | %s | %s |\n' "$gh" "$gh" "$(status_badge "$h")" "$age_disp" "$star_disp" "$tool_disp"
    done
    echo
    echo "Powered by [osalt.dev](https://osalt.dev) · full freshness leaderboard at [osalt.dev/freshness](https://osalt.dev/freshness/)."
  } >>"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi

# 6. Fail-on gate -----------------------------------------------------------
if [ -n "$FAIL_ON" ]; then
  IFS=',' read -ra GATES <<<"$FAIL_ON"
  for g in "${GATES[@]}"; do
    g="$(echo "$g" | awk '{$1=$1;print}')"
    case "$g" in
      alive)   [ "$alive"   -gt 0 ] && { echo "::error::fail-on=alive matched ($alive)"; exit 1; } ;;
      stale)   [ "$stale"   -gt 0 ] && { echo "::error::fail-on=stale matched ($stale)"; exit 1; } ;;
      dead)    [ "$dead"    -gt 0 ] && { echo "::error::fail-on=dead matched ($dead)"; exit 1; } ;;
      unknown) [ "$unknown" -gt 0 ] && { echo "::error::fail-on=unknown matched ($unknown)"; exit 1; } ;;
    esac
  done
fi

echo "osalt-freshness: alive=$alive stale=$stale dead=$dead unknown=$unknown"
